name: maintain-discatsharp
tagline_zh: 改 DisCatSharp 源码、加 API、调序列化、跑多目标测试？它连 DocFX 文档和发布说明都包了。
tagline_en: Tweak DisCatSharp source, add APIs, fix serialization, run multi-target tests? It even handles DocFX docs and.
desc_en: Review, modify, test, document, or release the DisCatSharp repository. Use for DisCatSharp source changes, API additions and migrations, Discord payload models, serialization, command synchronization, Gateway dispatch, REST behavior, analyzer work, multi-target testing, DocFX generation, release notes, and repository pull requests.
why_zh: 同类工具只改代码，它连文档生成、发布说明和 PR 流程都接管，一条龙不遗漏。
why_en: Unlike code-only tools, it also owns DocFX docs, release notes, and PR flow—no loose ends.
